The frozen repeated_nonadvancing_scroll_loop is also a competing defect sufficient to explain the failure, so strong linkage is unavailable.

summary: The evaluator reports that a required image was not saved. The frozen continuous scrolling loop plausibly contributed indirectly, while the frozen competing loop defect is itself a sufficient alternative failure explanation.
